calls.prompt:
Extract the policy metadata using only the supplied privacy policy text.
For list fields, use only the allowed labels. For status fields, use yes, no, or unclear.
Use no only for an explicit denial; use unclear when the policy does not say.
Do not use outside knowledge. Return one JSON object with a fields object.
Each list field has value (array of allowed labels) and evidence (mapping labels to quote arrays).
Each status field has value (yes/no/unclear) and evidence (quote array).
Evidence quotations, if provided, must be exact contiguous text from the source.
Empty list values use []; absent status information uses unclear.
Allowed list labels:
- dataTypeTags: location, voice_recording, eye_tracking, device_id, payment_info, contact_info
- dataSourceTypes: user_provided, device_sensor, third_party_login, cookies, xr_headset_sensor
- collectionContext: during_payment, account_registration, service_usage, customer_support
- processingPurpose: advertising, analytics, payment_processing, service_provision, security
- permittedUsage: service_operation, personalization, marketing, product_improvement
- thirdPartySources: google_login, facebook_login, payment_processor
- downstreamStakeholders: cloud_provider, analytics_provider, advertising_partner, payment_processor, email_provider
- thirdPartyPurpose: payment_processing, analytics, advertising, service_delivery, authentication, email_delivery
- regulatoryFramework: GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, HIPAA
Status field meanings:
- sharingCondition: yes if it states conditions or limits for third-party sharing; no if it explicitly says data is not shared; otherwise unclear
- consentRequired: whether consent is required for a stated processing activity
- optOutAvailable: whether a user can opt out of a stated processing activity
- deletionAvailable: whether a user can request or perform data deletion
- requestChannel: whether a channel is given for privacy or data-rights requests
- retentionPolicy: whether a data retention or deletion rule is stated
- encryptionApplied: whether encryption of data is stated
- anonymisation: whether anonymisation or de-identification is stated
- crossBorderTransfer: whether cross-border data transfer is stated
- childDataInvolved: whether the service collects or processes children's data
- contactChannel: whether a privacy-related contact channel is provided

<policy_chunk>
Oberon Privacy Policy
We Respect Your Privacy
Oberon Technologies respects your privacy and understands how important it is to protect the personal information you provide to us. By using our Web site, you consent to the collection and use of your personal information by Oberon Technologies strictly for marketing or reference purposes only. As an example, you may want to contact us or send us sample information for our viewing (such as sample files, resumes, etc.). This information will be used appropriately and only for its intended purpose, will be kept secure, and will be deleted from the website on a regularly scheduled basis. If you have questions regarding our Privacy Policy, please contact us.
By accessing the Oberon Technologies website (oberontech.wpengine.com), you acknowledge the terms and conditions expressed herein. We reserve the right to change this policy at our sole discretion and without notice.
Oberon Technologies utilizes industry standard technology such as firewalls, intrusion monitoring, and passwords to protect electronic information. This technology helps protect our domain as well as provides us a method to capture information about you to improve our website and/or send you following up information. The information we capture allows us to understand the types of information you are accessing from our website and in return, allows us to improve the information we provide in order to serve your needs.
Normally, Oberon Technologies does not sell, trade, or transfer any information you provide to us via our Web site to any third party. However, we may share certain information with our business partners for marketing, advertising, or offering products or services.
Oberon Technologies web site may contain links to other internet web sites. Oberon Technologies neither controls nor endorses external sites and is not responsible for the content of such sites. This policy does not cover the privacy policies and data collection practices of non-Oberon Technologies web sites.
</policy_chunk>
